findings.summary: experimental.serverActions.bodySizeLimit raised to 28mb app-wide (no per-action override exists in this Next version per bundled docs), widening the resource-consumption/DoS surface for every unrelated Server Action (toggleKudoHeart, loadMoreKudos, logout, etc.); re-verified this pass, unchanged, still a reasoned and documented trade-off (AD-4)

reads process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, a variable name used nowhere else in this repo (every other spec and app source file uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY), with a fallback string that decodes to only a JWT header (no payload/signature) and cannot function as a real credential -- not a secret-leak (publishable keys are public by design) but a portability bug that would fail the @auth @local-db tier on any environment that only sets the repo's documented env var name
kudos_cards view carries forward a pre-existing (0006) correlated subquery per row for sender/receiver kudos_received counts; not introduced by this change but will not scale indefinitely
no server-side max length on content/title/anonymous_name beyond the 28MB body limit; deliberate no-invented-limit call per clarifications, noted for completeness
only the first rejected image's reason is surfaced when multiple images fail validation at once
